sources.document_title: STUSB4500 standalone USB PD sink controller with short-to-VBUS protections
sources.locator: Section 2, Table 1, QFN pin-function rows; Sections 2.2.1 through 2.2.16
sources.evidence_extract: QFN pins 1..24 and EP are enumerated. CC is Hi-Z in reset; CCDB enables passive dead-battery Rd. DISCH and VBUS_VS_DISCH have distinct sense/discharge roles. VBUS_EN_SNK is active-low open drain.

sources.locator: Sections 3.22 through 3.25, register tables 0x25 through 0x29; Sections 3.60 through 3.72
sources.evidence_extract: NVM initializes startup registers. Discharge timing defaults are 800 ms to 0 V and 270 ms between contracts; forced discharge control is separate. PDO registers are volatile R/W views initialized by NVM.

sources.document_title: Getting started with the STEVAL-ISC005V1 evaluation board for STUSB4500
sources.locator: Section 1.1, board overview and PDO list; schematic figures
sources.evidence_extract: Autonomous dead-battery reference board presents Rd, requests 5 V, negotiates PDOs, and demonstrates switched/discharged VBUS plus programmer interface.

sources.locator: Cover Description section, lines describing STUSB-NVM.h export and automatic NVM load
sources.evidence_extract: The library loads a GUI-exported STUSB-NVM.h image automatically and supports read/write customization workflows.

sources.document_title: PESD24VS1UB ESD protection diode in SOD523 package
sources.locator: Section 9, Table 6 characteristic rows; Section 11, Figure 10 package outline
sources.evidence_extract: VRWM 24 V; VBR 26.5 to 27.5 V at 5 mA; VCL max 36 V at 1 A and 70 V at 3 A for 8/20 us; unidirectional SOD523.
